Cypress Capital Management Wy Has Cut By $301,435 Its Apple (AAPL) Holding; Trustmark National Bank Trust Department Lifted Glaxosmithkline Plc (GSK) Holding By $1.64 Million
June 16, 2018 - By Hazel Jackson
Trustmark National Bank Trust Department increased Glaxosmithkline Plc (GSK) stake by 66.38% reported in 2018Q1 SEC filing. Trustmark National Bank Trust Department acquired 42,143 shares as Glaxosmithkline Plc (GSK)’s stock rose 7.70%. The Trustmark National Bank Trust Department holds 105,626 shares with $4.13 million value, up from 63,483 last quarter. Glaxosmithkline Plc now has $102.33 billion valuation. The stock decreased 1.19% or $0.5 during the last trading session, reaching $41.44. About 2.44 million shares traded. GlaxoSmithKline plc (NYSE:GSK) has declined 6.39% since June 16, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 18.96% the S&P500.
